pages.text: Weigh your armor before you build a kit — every piece is $(bold)robe$(), $(bold)light$(), $(bold)medium$(), or $(bold)heavy$(), and the class shifts your mana regen, speed, and armor.$(br2)Effects scale with the count of equipped pieces, so a hybrid kit (two heavy + two light) lands proportionally between the extremes.$(br2)Untagged armor defaults to medium (no effect).

pages.title: Robe & Light
pages.text: $(5)Robe$() — true mage gear:$(br)$(li2)+0.10$() mana regen$(br)$(li2)+1.5%$() movement speed$(br)$(li2)-7.5%$() base armor$(br)$(li2)-10%$() armor toughness$(br2)$(t1)Light$() — rogue/agile cloth + leather:$(br)$(li2)+0.05$() mana regen$(br)$(li2)+5%$() movement speed$(br)$(li2)-5%$() base armor$(br)$(li2)-7.5%$() armor toughness

pages.title: Heavy
pages.text: $(t3)Heavy$() — diamond, netherite, plate:$(br)$(li2)-0.05$() mana regen$(br)$(li2)-5%$() movement speed$(br)$(li2)+5%$() base armor$(br2)Medium (everything untagged) carries no modifiers at all — it is the neutral baseline the other classes trade against.

pages.title: Robe set bonus
pages.text: Wearing $(bold)4 robe pieces$() unlocks the $(5)True Mage$() set bonus: an additional $(li2)+0.5$() mana regen on top of the per-piece total.$(br2)Final 4/4 robe: $(li2)+0.9$() mana regen, $(li2)+6%$() speed, $(li2)-30%$() armor, $(li2)-40%$() toughness.$(br2)This is the payoff for committing to a real caster build instead of mixing in plate. Robes are deliberately the most fragile tier - the bonus has to be worth it.

pages.title: Full-kit extremes
pages.text: $(bold)4 robe$(): +0.9 mana, +6% speed, -30% armor, -40% toughness$(br2)$(bold)4 light$(): +0.20 mana, +20% speed, -20% armor, -30% toughness$(br2)$(bold)4 heavy$(): -0.20 mana, -20% speed, +20% armor, no toughness change$(br2)$(warn)Robes are doubly fragile.$() Toughness penalty stacks asymmetrically - heavy doesn't add toughness back. Diamond/netherite already carry high native toughness; the system amplifies the gap rather than re-dosing it.

pages.title: What's tagged Robe & Light
pages.text: $(5)Robe$() — Iron's Spellbooks class robes (Wizard, Pyromancer, Cryomancer, Electromancer, Cultist, Plagued, Priest, Wandering Magician, Archevoker, Netherite Battlemage), Botania manaweave, Terramity void mage + exodium warlock sets, and Iridescent Reforging mage majors (vestments).$(br2)$(t1)Light$() — cloaks, hats, accessories, agile rogue gear (Shadow-Walker, pumpkin), and Iridescent Reforging light/scaled majors.

pages.title: What's tagged Heavy
pages.text: $(t3)Heavy$() — vanilla diamond + netherite, Aether obsidian/phoenix/valkyrie/gravitite, Aquaculture neptunium, Botania terrasteel, Cataclysm ignitium, Forbidden & Arcanus draco arcanus + tyr, Twilight Forest fiery + knightmetal, Undergarden froststeel + utherium, and more.$(br2)Everything else (vanilla iron + gold, mid-tier modded metals) is medium.$(br2)Reforged armor is classed dynamically — the installed major module decides the tier, so a vestment crown counts as robe regardless of material.

pages.title: Checking your totals
pages.text: Weight modifiers stack additively per slot and re-apply the moment you swap a piece. They sit on top of base armor stats, Apotheosis affixes, and every other attribute source.$(br2)$(bold)Next: open your inventory ($(k:inventory)) and click Show Attributes$() — the armor, toughness, speed, and mana lines show exactly what your current kit adds up to.
